| id(bytes=1)="\u{1B}" |
+----------------------+

+-----------------------+
| Same                  |

+-----------------------+

+----------------------+
| Bridge               |
| id(bytes=6)="bridge" |
+----------------------+

relations:
id(bytes=1)="\u{1B}" ||--|| id(bytes=6)="bridge"  : first
id(bytes=6)="bridge" ||--|| id(bytes=6)="\\u{1B}" : second
id(bytes=1)="\u{1B}" ||--|| id(bytes=6)="\\u{1B}" : spanning
